text:
Maya (Marketing): Voxlane signed off for a customer story. Need interview, quote approval, legal opt-in, and webinar tie-in. Who can take what?
Jon (PMM): I'll draft the hero stat. Suggest focusing on cost-per-call and reliability.
Riley (Content): I'll draft interview guide and social teasers. Keep quotes short.
Sam (CSM): Customer can do a 25-30m interview next Thu afternoon. They want to review quotes before publish.
Priya (Legal): Send opt-in + any perf snapshots to legal@redwood. If we publish numbers include test date and note "internal tests".
Ethan (Sales): After webinar, route leads to AE queue 'Voxlane-launch'. Tag attendees by role.
Tara (Voxlane): Confirm Thu works. We'll share an anonymized metric extract and one dashboard screenshot. Embargo? We prefer a 5-business-day internal review.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Voxlane case study interview" Thu 15:30 - attendees: Maya, Riley, Sam, Tara.
Jon (PMM): Draft hero: 'Cut average inference cost per call by 28% and reduced p99 latency by 35% (internal tests, May 2026)'. Will add softer fallback.
Riley (Content): Interview bullets: deployment timeline, measurement method, operational wins, advice. Will produce hero stat, 2 soundbites, 2 teaser lines, and a benchmark appendix PDF.
Sam (CSM): I'll upload the metrics sheet to the private drive and cc Priya.
Priya (Legal): Once I get the sheet + methods note, I'll review in 24-48h. If numbers are contested we'll change to relative language.
Maya (Marketing): Timeline: interview Thu, legal review by Mon, assets staged next Wed, embargo ends after their internal review + 5 business days -> publish + webinar mention week after. Any blockers?
Ethan (Sales): Make sure webinar form captures company size and primary persona.
Tara (Voxlane): We'll anonymize IDs in logs. Confirmed one screenshot only.
Riley (Content): Will watermark screenshot and keep raw logs in appendix for legal review only.
Maya (Marketing): Closing loop: Jon finalizes hero stat, Sam posts metrics, Priya reviews, Riley drafts assets. Thanks all. If anything slips flag here.
